LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Novice_1: {PAWN} leaned on a debtor who suddenly remembered where they'd put the caps.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Novice_2: {PAWN} scouted a chem deal that fell through, but came back with a good sense of who's buying.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Novice_3: {PAWN} ran off a couple of scavengers picking through tribe territory.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Novice_4: {PAWN} spent the run chasing down a lead on a rival gang's stash.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Veteran_1: {PAWN} settled a score that had been owed to the tribe for a long time.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Veteran_2: {PAWN} shook a debt loose from someone who thought the Khans had forgotten.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the warpath mapping a rival's territory, marking it for the next ride.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back with a busted lip and a story the whole camp will hear tonight.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Elite_1: {PAWN} rode in alone where a whole party would've gotten noticed, and rode back out clean.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the job exactly as planned, in, done, gone before anyone could react.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks off the beaten path and came back with news the tribe will want to hear.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about the run, just parked the bike and asked what's next.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past anything the tribe's ever claimed, scouting ground for the next warpath.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from unclaimed territory with word of a stretch ready to fall under the tribe's name.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks out of contact and returned with news the Great Khan will want to hear in person.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Khan_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} rode back into camp carrying proof of what was found out past the edge of the map, road dust and dried blood in equal measure.
